capabilities: Visualize tasks, plans and notes as layered, connectable nodes
Group and manage text, image, table, management, goal and delegation node types
Interact with animated characters that move, jump, work and trigger story events
Use built-in phone apps for diary, memos, photo album, video, pomodoro and email
Store business data in vault folders for backup and multi-device sync
disambiguation: Not a note-graph tool like Graph view; it is a gamified personal planning workspace whose nodes link to plans, goals, tables and media.
extras: Paid proprietary software with a private code repository; activation contacts a license server. Desktop-only. Documents network access, privacy practices and data storage locations, with full privacy details in PRIVACY.md and optional asset packs from the A-My-Island-Releases GitHub repository.
problem: Obsidian organizes planning and life data as flat notes and lists; this plugin offers a visual, game-like island interface for the same content.

relations.evidence: This plugin uses Cytoscape.js, licensed under the MIT License.

summary: Gamified island workspace that renders tasks, notes, plans, tables and characters as interactive nodes on a Cytoscape.js canvas, with built-in phone-style apps.
